Game Tile Generator

Flat multicolour tile for board games and game prototypes: one body per colour, so each gets its own filament.
Each colour is set into the top face (colour depth) and most stand out in relief: raised stones, waves, drops and rocks, upright grass blades and flames, a standing door; mortar, seams, cracks and the pit are sunk. Asphalt and the chequers stay flat. Printed as shown, pattern up, no supports. The thickness has no upper limit: make it as thick as the tile is wide for a block or cube. Regular patterns (sand, road, bricks, chequers, planks) continue onto the next square or rectangular tile; random details change with the variation number, and each tile in a set gets its own.
Choose a tile and click Generate.
